children: TotalEnergies SE (EURONEXT:TTE) is reshaping its portfolio—cutting to 20% in Papua LNG as ExxonMobil takes operatorship and capex falls to ~$14B, while boosting Angola and offshore growth via Acacia-5, Kaminho and new exploration stakes, plus a €1.5bn note redemption amid tight gas markets.
: TotalEnergies cut stake in Papua LNG to 20% after selling 9.1%. ExxonMobil will operate. Project capex trimmed to ~$14B; EPC contracts recommended. Total secured 1.5 Mtpa offtake.

: TotalEnergies (TTE) discovered oil at Acacia-5 in Angola’s Block 17 and agreed to acquire a 40% operated interest in exploration Blocks 17/25 and 32/21, planning tie‑backs to existing infrastructure.
: TotalEnergies (TTE) benefits from rising gas prices and low European inventories; CEO Pouyanne says no physical supply risk, Europe competing with Asia for LNG, oil outlook uncertain.
: TotalEnergies (TTE) will irrevocably redeem €1.5bn of undated non-call 10y subordinated notes on 6 Oct 2026 at €103,369 per €100,000, covering principal plus accrued interest.
: TotalEnergies (TTE) greenlit the $6B Kaminho offshore project in 2024; linked to its seventh FPSO, production is slated to start in 2028 off Angola—key for TTE production growth.
